methodology.eligibility: Direct advertising campaign/account operations, bidding/budgets, audiences, advertising creative, advertising performance/attribution, or media buying supported by first-party documentation or static code. General agents, ordinary AI tools, non-advertising marketing and inferred adaptations excluded. Mixed-scope repositories are recommended only for explicitly advertising-specific components.
methodology.ranking: Observed total GitHub Stars descending per main/watch group. Not a verified industry popularity ranking, user count, real spend or effectiveness metric.
methodology.delta_semantics: Stars/Forks change since each observation on 2026-11-04. Elapsed 12.7–12.8 hours across refreshed repositories, not a 24-hour daily measure. First-time selections have no baseline.
methodology.push_semantics: pushed_at may refer to a non-default branch. Default-branch commit identities and compare are checked separately.
methodology.verification: README and selected source files read at observed default-branch HEAD. Blob SHA1 and SHA256 retained. No candidates installed or run; no advertising accounts authorized or changed.
methodology.prototype_boundary: A repo can qualify as directly advertising-related while remaining a research prototype or hosted client; no production or performance implication.
